subject: general
question: Which is NOT an agency of United Nations?
solution:
**The correct answer is __Red Cross International Committee__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) was founded in 1863 in Geneva, Switzerland, by Henry Dunant, inspired by the need to assist those wounded in war.**
 
• **The ICRC works worldwide in areas affected by conflict, disaster, and violence, often coordinating with Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies in over 190 countries. **
